production_method: built-in image generation expanded the reviewed harbor districts into a native-width 1920x1024 master; deterministic ImageMagick registration, shared-boundary finishing and alpha reconstruction export each district without enlargement

chunks.role: naval repair and logistics choke point

rules: No ships or complete cranes are baked into geography.
Every chunk has a broad navigable water channel.
Adjacent chunks close at zero scanline error.
Recognizable port districts do not repeat at the former 720-pixel interval.
Every harbor district enters the build at its final 640-pixel runtime width; the builder may not enlarge an undersized plate.
Native low-altitude captures must preserve crisp dock joints, rails, tetrapods, hazard markings and machinery without widened proportions.
